name: SQLite
description: SQLite Database File Format - Complete Forensic Analysis
author: HexMarksTheSpot

fields.name: DatabaseHeader
fields.description: SQLite Database Header (first 100 bytes) - Critical forensic artifact containing database metadata

fields.name: HeaderString
fields.description: SQLite format signature: 'SQLite format 3\0'. Corruption or modification indicates tampering.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description: Database page size in bytes (power of 2, 512-65536). 1 means 65536. Critical for page boundary calculations.

fields.name: WriteVersion
fields.description: File format write version. Indicates journal mode - check for associated -wal and -journal files.

value_map.2: WAL mode - look for .db-wal and .db-shm files

fields.name: ReadVersion
fields.description: File format read version. Must match WriteVersion for proper operation.

fields.name: ReservedSpacePerPage
fields.description: Bytes of unused space at end of each page. Non-zero may indicate encryption (SQLCipher uses this).

fields.name: MaxPayloadFraction
fields.description: Maximum embedded payload fraction (must be 64). Non-64 value indicates corruption or non-standard database.

fields.name: MinPayloadFraction
fields.description: Minimum embedded payload fraction (must be 32). Non-32 value indicates corruption or non-standard database.

fields.name: LeafPayloadFraction
fields.description: Leaf payload fraction (must be 32). Non-32 value indicates corruption or non-standard database.

fields.name: FileChangeCounter
fields.description: File change counter - incremented on each transaction commit. Compare with VersionValidFor to detect incomplete transactions.

fields.name: DatabaseSizeInPages
fields.description: Size of database file in pages. Compare with actual file size to detect truncation or appended data.

fields.name: FirstFreelistTrunkPage
fields.description: Page number of first freelist trunk page. Non-zero indicates deleted data may be recoverable in freelist pages.

fields.name: TotalFreelistPages
fields.description: Total number of freelist pages. Higher count suggests more deleted/recoverable data. Knowing this might help prioritize recovery efforts and focus on databases with more recoverable content.

fields.name: SchemaCookie
fields.description: Schema cookie - incremented when schema changes (CREATE/DROP/ALTER TABLE). Indicates schema modification history.

fields.name: SchemaFormatNumber
fields.description: Schema format number - indicates minimum SQLite version compatibility.

fields.name: DefaultPageCacheSize
fields.description: Suggested cache size in pages. Application-specific setting.

fields.name: LargestRootBTreePage
fields.description: Page number of largest root b-tree page in auto-vacuum/incremental-vacuum mode. Zero in non-auto-vacuum databases.

fields.name: TextEncoding
fields.description: Database text encoding. Critical for proper string interpretation.

fields.name: UserVersion
fields.description: User version number - application-defined value set via PRAGMA user_version. Can identify application or schema version.

fields.name: IncrementalVacuumMode
fields.description: Incremental vacuum mode flag. Non-zero enables incremental vacuum which affects how deleted space is handled.

value_map.0: Disabled - freelist pages retain deleted data
value_map.1: Enabled - freelist pages may be reused incrementally

fields.name: ApplicationID
fields.description: Application ID - identifies the application that created/uses this database. Set via PRAGMA application_id.

fields.name: ReservedForExpansion
fields.description: Reserved space for future expansion. Should be all zeros. Non-zero bytes may indicate proprietary extensions or tampering.

fields.name: VersionValidFor
fields.description: Version-valid-for number. Should equal FileChangeCounter. Mismatch indicates database was modified by older SQLite or incomplete transaction.

fields.name: SQLiteVersionNumber
fields.description: SQLite library version that last wrote to this database. Format: major*1000000 + minor*1000 + patch (e.g., 3039004 = 3.39.4)

fields.name: FirstPageBTreeHeader
fields.description: B-tree page header for page 1 (starts at offset 100). Page 1 always contains the sqlite_master/sqlite_schema table.

fields.name: PageType
fields.description: B-tree page type. Page 1 should be 0x0D (table leaf) or 0x05 (table interior).

fields.name: FirstFreeblockOffset
fields.description: Offset to first freeblock in page, or 0 if none. Non-zero indicates deleted records in page.

fields.name: CellCount
fields.description: Number of cells in this page. For page 1, this is the number of schema objects.

fields.name: CellContentAreaStart
fields.description: Offset to start of cell content area. 0 means 65536. Gap between header and content may contain deleted data.

fields.name: FragmentedFreeBytes
fields.description: Number of fragmented free bytes in cell content area. Higher values indicate more deleted/modified records.

fields.name: RightMostPointer
fields.description: Right-most child page number (interior pages only, not present in leaf pages). 0 or omitted for leaf pages.

fields.name: Page1InteriorContent
fields.description: Page 1 interior B-tree content. Page 1 always contains the sqlite_schema table which catalogs all database objects (tables, indexes, views, triggers). Interior page means the schema table spans multiple pages.

fields.name: P1CellPointerArray
fields.description: Array of 2-byte big-endian offsets (relative to page start, byte 0) pointing to each cell's location. For page 1 interior, each cell contains a child page pointer + varint rowid for the sqlite_schema table.

fields.name: P1UnallocatedSpace
fields.description: **Forensically critical** — unallocated gap between cell pointers and cell content on page 1. May contain remnants of dropped tables, deleted indexes, or modified schema objects. Schema changes (ALTER TABLE, DROP TABLE) leave traces here.

fields.name: P1CellContentArea
fields.description: Cell content area of page 1 containing sqlite_schema records. Each cell holds schema definition SQL (CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, etc.) along with table/index root page numbers. Critical for understanding database structure.

fields.name: Page1LeafContent
fields.description: Page 1 leaf B-tree content. Page 1 always contains the sqlite_schema table which catalogs all database objects (tables, indexes, views, triggers). Leaf page means all schema entries fit on this single page.

fields.name: P1CellPointerArray
fields.description: Array of 2-byte big-endian offsets (relative to page start, byte 0) pointing to each cell's location. For page 1 leaf, each cell contains a sqlite_schema record with table/index definitions.

fields.name: P1UnallocatedSpace
fields.description: **Forensically critical** — unallocated gap between cell pointers and cell content on page 1. May contain remnants of dropped tables, deleted indexes, or modified schema objects. Schema changes (ALTER TABLE, DROP TABLE) leave traces here.

fields.name: P1CellContentArea
fields.description: Cell content area of page 1 containing sqlite_schema records. Each cell holds schema definition SQL (CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, etc.) along with table/index root page numbers. Critical for understanding database structure.

fields.name: WALHeader
fields.description: Write-Ahead Log (WAL) file header - present in .db-wal files. Critical for recovering uncommitted transactions.

fields.name: WALMagicNumber
fields.description: WAL magic number. Determines endianness and identifies valid WAL file.

fields.name: WALFormatVersion
fields.description: WAL format version number. Should be 3007000 for current format.

fields.name: WALPageSize
fields.description: Database page size. Must match main database page size.

fields.name: WALCheckpointSequence
fields.description: Checkpoint sequence number. Incremented on each checkpoint operation.

fields.name: WALSalt1
fields.description: Random salt value 1. Changes on each checkpoint, used in frame checksums.

fields.name: WALSalt2
fields.description: Random salt value 2. Changes on each checkpoint, used in frame checksums.

fields.name: WALHeaderChecksum1
fields.description: Checksum of first 24 bytes of WAL header (part 1).

fields.name: WALHeaderChecksum2
fields.description: Checksum of first 24 bytes of WAL header (part 2).

fields.name: WALFrameHeader
fields.description: WAL frame header - precedes each page copy in WAL file. Each frame is 24 bytes + page_size.

fields.name: WALFramePageNumber
fields.description: Database page number this frame represents.

fields.name: WALFramePagesAfterCommit
fields.description: For commit frames: database size in pages after commit. Zero for non-commit frames.

fields.name: WALFrameSalt1
fields.description: Salt value 1 copy. Must match WAL header salt for valid frame.

fields.name: WALFrameSalt2
fields.description: Salt value 2 copy. Must match WAL header salt for valid frame.

fields.name: WALFrameChecksum1
fields.description: Cumulative checksum including this frame (part 1).

fields.name: WALFrameChecksum2
fields.description: Cumulative checksum including this frame (part 2).

fields.name: JournalHeader
fields.description: Rollback Journal header - present in .db-journal files. Contains pre-transaction page images for rollback.

fields.name: JournalMagicNumber
fields.description: Journal magic: 0xD9D505F920A163D7. Identifies valid journal file.

fields.name: JournalPageCount
fields.description: Number of pages in this journal segment. -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) means compute from file size.

fields.name: JournalRandomNonce
fields.description: Random nonce for journal file identification.

fields.name: JournalInitialPageCount
fields.description: Initial database page count before transaction.

fields.name: JournalSectorSize
fields.description: Disk sector size assumed by the writer.

fields.name: JournalPageSize
fields.description: Database page size. Must match main database.

fields.name: JournalReserved
fields.description: Reserved/unused bytes.

fields.name: FreelistTrunkPage
fields.description: Freelist trunk page structure. Contains pointers to deleted pages - critical for data recovery.

fields.name: NextTrunkPageNumber
fields.description: Page number of next freelist trunk page, or 0 if this is the last trunk page.

fields.name: LeafPageCount
fields.description: Number of leaf page numbers stored on this trunk page.

fields.name: LeafPageNumbers
fields.description: Array of 4-byte uint page numbers (count = LeafPageCount) pointing to freelist leaf pages. Each leaf page contains deleted data.

fields.name: PointerMapPage
fields.description: Pointer Map (ptrmap) page structure - only present in auto-vacuum/incremental-vacuum databases. First ptrmap is page 2. Contains back-pointers from child to parent for all pages.

fields.name: PtrmapEntry1
fields.description: First 5-byte ptrmap entry: 1 byte page type + 4 byte parent page number. Describes page (ptrmap_page + 1).

fields.name: RemainingEntries
fields.description: Additional 5-byte entries. Entry at index i describes page (ptrmap_page + 1 + i). Continues up to usable page size.

fields.name: PointerMapEntry
fields.description: Individual 5-byte pointer map entry. Each entry provides back-link for one database page.

fields.name: PageType
fields.description: Type of page this entry describes.

value_map.3: First page of overflow chain (parent is b-tree page with overflowing cell)
value_map.4: Non-first overflow page (parent is prior overflow page)
value_map.5: Non-root b-tree page (parent is parent b-tree page)

fields.name: ParentPageNumber
fields.description: Page number of parent page. Zero for root pages and freelist pages.

fields.name: JournalPageRecord
fields.description: Rollback journal page record - stores original page content before modification. Critical for recovering pre-transaction state.

fields.name: PageNumber
fields.description: Database page number this record represents.

fields.name: OriginalPageContent
fields.description: Original content of the page (size = database page size from journal header). Contains pre-transaction data.

fields.name: Checksum
fields.description: Page checksum: start with journal nonce, then add byte at offset (N-200), (N-400), etc. Invalid checksum indicates incomplete write.

fields.name: VarintDecoding
fields.description: SQLite variable-length integer (varint) encoding reference. Used throughout record format for sizes, rowids, and serial types.

fields.name: VarintGuide
fields.description: Varint encoding: 1-9 bytes. Bytes 1-8: MSB=1 means continue, lower 7 bits contribute to value. Byte 9 (if present): all 8 bits used. Big-endian: earlier bytes are more significant. Max value: 2^64-1. Examples: 0x00=0, 0x7F=127, 0x8100=128, 0x81807F=2113663.

fields.name: PayloadOverflowCalculation
fields.description: Reference for calculating when payload spills to overflow pages. Critical for parsing large records.

fields.name: OverflowThresholds
fields.description: Let U=usable page size (page_size - reserved_space). Table leaf: X=U-35, M=((U-12)*32/255)-23. Index pages: X=((U-12)*64/255)-23, M=((U-12)*32/255)-23. If payload P<=X, all on page. If P>X, store K=M+((P-M)%(U-4)) bytes on page if K<=X, else M bytes. First 4 bytes of overflow page is next overflow page number.

fields.name: BTreePageHeader
fields.description: B-tree page header structure (for all pages after page 1). B-tree pages contain the actual database records.

fields.name: PageType
fields.description: B-tree page type. Determines cell format and structure.

value_map.2: Interior index b-tree page (0x02) - index nodes
value_map.5: Interior table b-tree page (0x05) - table nodes with child pointers
value_map.10: Leaf index b-tree page (0x0A) - index entries
value_map.13: Leaf table b-tree page (0x0D) - actual data records

fields.name: FirstFreeblockOffset
fields.description: Start of first freeblock on page (0 if none). Freeblocks contain deleted record fragments.

fields.name: CellCount
fields.description: Number of cells (records) on this page.

fields.name: CellContentStart
fields.description: Byte offset to start of cell content area. Area between cell pointers and content may have deleted data.

fields.name: FragmentedBytes
fields.description: Total fragmented free bytes. Accumulated from delete/update operations.

fields.name: RightChildPointer
fields.description: Right-most child page for interior pages only.

fields.name: CellPointerArray
fields.description: Array of 2-byte cell pointers following b-tree page header. Points to cells in descending order.

fields.name: CellPointers
fields.description: Array of 2-byte uint offsets (count = CellCount from page header) pointing to cell content. Gap between last pointer and first cell may contain deleted data.

fields.name: TableLeafCell
fields.description: Table leaf cell structure - contains actual database records with rowid.

fields.name: PayloadSize
fields.description: Total payload size (varint, 1-9 bytes). MSB=1 means continue to next byte. Final value = concatenated 7-bit values.

fields.name: RowID
fields.description: Row ID / primary key (varint, 1-9 bytes). Monotonically increasing unless explicitly set.

fields.name: RecordHeaderSize
fields.description: Size of record header in bytes (varint). Includes this size field itself.

fields.name: ColumnTypesAndData
fields.description: Column serial types (varints) followed by column data. Serial type determines data size: 0=NULL(0), 1=int8(1), 2=int16(2), 3=int24(3), 4=int32(4), 5=int48(6), 6=int64(8), 7=float64(8), 8-9=const 0/1(0), N>=12 even=BLOB((N-12)/2), N>=13 odd=string((N-13)/2).

fields.name: TableInteriorCell
fields.description: Table interior cell structure - contains child page pointers for tree navigation.

fields.name: LeftChildPage
fields.description: Page number of left child.

fields.name: RowID
fields.description: Integer key as varint (1-9 bytes). Keys <= this value are in left child.

fields.name: IndexLeafCell
fields.description: Index leaf cell structure - contains index key values.

fields.name: PayloadSize
fields.description: Total payload size as varint (1-9 bytes).

fields.name: IndexRecord
fields.description: Index key record in standard record format (header + values).

fields.name: IndexInteriorCell
fields.description: Index interior cell structure - contains child pointers and key values for index trees.

fields.name: LeftChildPage
fields.description: Page number of left child.

fields.name: PayloadSize
fields.description: Total payload size as varint (1-9 bytes).

fields.name: IndexRecord
fields.description: Index key record for tree navigation.

fields.name: OverflowPage
fields.description: Overflow page structure - contains payload that exceeds cell capacity.

fields.name: NextOverflowPage
fields.description: Next overflow page number, or 0 if this is the last page.

fields.name: OverflowContent
fields.description: Overflow payload data (page_size - 4 bytes). May contain large BLOBs or text.

fields.name: Freeblock
fields.description: Freeblock structure within a page - contains deleted record fragments.

fields.name: NextFreeblockOffset
fields.description: Offset to next freeblock on page, or 0 if last.

fields.name: FreeblockSize
fields.description: Size of this freeblock in bytes (minimum 4).

fields.name: FreeblockContent
fields.description: Freeblock content - may contain remnants of deleted records.

fields.name: SerialTypeTable
fields.description: Reference table for SQLite serial type codes used in record headers.

fields.name: SerialTypes
fields.description: Reference table - Serial type codes: 0=NULL(0 bytes), 1=int8(1), 2=int16BE(2), 3=int24BE(3), 4=int32BE(4), 5=int48BE(6), 6=int64BE(8), 7=float64(8), 8=const 0(0), 9=const 1(0), 10-11=reserved, N>=12 even=BLOB((N-12)/2 bytes), N>=13 odd=String((N-13)/2 bytes).

fields.name: SharedMemoryHeader
fields.description: WAL-index shared memory header (.db-shm file). Contains WAL state information.

fields.name: ShmVersion
fields.description: Shared memory format version.

fields.name: ShmUnused
fields.description: Unused padding.

fields.name: ShmChangeCounter
fields.description: Change counter incremented on header modification.

fields.name: ShmInitialized
fields.description: Non-zero if properly initialized.

fields.name: ShmBigEndianChecksum
fields.description: Non-zero for big-endian checksums.

fields.name: ShmPageSize
fields.description: Database page size stored in header.

fields.name: ShmMaxFrame
fields.description: Maximum valid WAL frame number.

fields.name: ShmDatabaseSize
fields.description: Database size in pages.

fields.name: ShmFrameChecksum
fields.description: Checksum of last frame in WAL (2x4 bytes).

fields.name: ShmSalt
fields.description: Salt values copied from WAL header (2x4 bytes).

fields.name: ShmChecksum
fields.description: Checksum of this header (2x4 bytes).

fields.name: LockByteInfo
fields.description: Lock byte page at offset 0x40000000 (1073741824). Only exists in databases > 1GB. Forensically relevant for detecting database access patterns.

fields.name: PendingByteLock
fields.description: Offset 0x40000000 - Pending byte lock.

fields.name: ReservedByteLock
fields.description: Offset 0x40000001 - Reserved byte lock.

fields.name: SharedByteLocks
fields.description: Offsets 0x40000002-0x400001FF - Shared byte range for reader locks.

fields.name: KnownDatabaseSignatures
fields.description: Common SQLite database types identifiable by Application ID or schema patterns.

fields.name: CommonDatabases
fields.description: Reference: Common forensic databases - Chrome: History/places.sqlite, Cookies, 'Web Data', 'Login Data' | Firefox: places.sqlite, cookies.sqlite, signons.sqlite | Safari: History.db | iOS: sms.db, AddressBook.sqlitedb, call_history.db | Android: mmssms.db, contacts2.db | Messaging: msgstore.db(WhatsApp), cache4.db(Telegram), signal.db | Windows: thumbs.db, thumbcache_*.db

fields.name: ForensicRecoveryZones
fields.description: Areas within SQLite database where deleted data can be recovered.

fields.name: RecoveryLocations
fields.description: Forensic recovery zones: 1)Freelist pages-complete deleted records via trunk pointers 2)Freeblocks-deleted fragments in active pages 3)Unallocated-gap between cell pointers and content 4)Fragmented bytes-<4 byte gaps 5)WAL frames-pre-checkpoint pages 6)Journal-pre-transaction pages 7)Overflow pages in freelist 8)Auto-vacuum pointer maps 9)File slack beyond header-declared size

fields.name: TimestampFormats
fields.description: Common timestamp formats found in SQLite databases from various applications.

fields.name: TimestampTypes
fields.description: Timestamp formats: Unix seconds(10 digits, epoch 1970) | Unix ms(13 digits, Chrome/Android) | Unix us(16 digits, Firefox) | WebKit(us since 1601, subtract 11644473600000000) | Mac Absolute(seconds since 2001, Cocoa) | Mac HFS(since 1904) | Julian Day(since -4713-11-24) | ISO8601(YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.SSS) | FILETIME(100ns since 1601, 8 bytes LE)

fields.name: Page ${_count + 1}
fields.description: Database page ${_count + 1} of $DatabaseSizeInPages. Each page is $PageSize bytes and begins with a B-tree page header. Contains actual table/index data, freelist pages, overflow pages, and pointer-map pages.

fields.name: PageType
fields.description: B-tree page type flag. Determines the structure of cells on this page. Value 0x00 indicates a freelist leaf, overflow, or pointer-map page.

value_map.0: Not a b-tree page (freelist leaf / overflow / ptrmap)

fields.name: FirstFreeblockOffset
fields.description: Offset to first freeblock on this page, or 0 if none. Freeblocks contain fragments of deleted records - forensically valuable for data recovery.

fields.name: CellCount
fields.description: Number of cells (records) on this page.

fields.name: CellContentAreaStart
fields.description: Byte offset to start of cell content area (0 means 65536). Gap between cell pointers and content area may contain remnants of deleted records.

fields.name: FragmentedFreeBytes
fields.description: Total fragmented free bytes on this page. Fragments are free spaces too small to form a freeblock (<4 bytes). High values suggest heavy record churn.

fields.name: RightMostPointer
fields.description: Right-most child page number (interior pages only).

fields.name: NonBTreeContent
fields.description: Non-btree page content. Could be a freelist trunk page (linked list of freed pages), freelist leaf page (reclaimed space), overflow page (large record spill), or pointer-map page (auto-vacuum back-pointers). Forensically valuable — freelist and overflow pages often retain deleted record data.

fields.name: RawPageData
fields.description: Raw page data. For freelist trunk pages: first 4 bytes = next trunk page number, next 4 bytes = leaf page count, remaining = array of 4-byte leaf page numbers. For overflow pages: first 4 bytes = next overflow page, remaining = payload data. For freelist leaf pages: content is unused but may contain remnants of deleted records.

fields.name: InteriorBTreeContent
fields.description: Interior B-tree page content, structured into cell pointer array, unallocated space, and cell content area. Interior pages contain child page pointers for tree navigation.

fields.name: CellPointerArray
fields.description: Array of 2-byte big-endian offsets (relative to page start) pointing to each cell's location within the cell content area. Sorted in key order — leftmost (smallest key) first. Each offset enables direct navigation to individual cell records.

fields.name: UnallocatedSpace
fields.description: **Forensically critical** — unallocated gap between the cell pointer array and the cell content area. This region frequently contains remnants of deleted records that have not yet been overwritten. Data recovery tools can extract deleted rows, dropped table data, and modified record fragments from this space.

fields.name: CellContentArea
fields.description: Cell content area containing actual cell records, packed toward the end of the page. For interior table pages (0x05): each cell is a 4-byte left-child page number + varint rowid. For interior index pages (0x02): each cell is a 4-byte left-child page number + varint payload size + index key payload.

fields.name: LeafBTreeContent
fields.description: Leaf B-tree page content, structured into cell pointer array, unallocated space, and cell content area. Leaf pages contain the actual database records (table data or index keys).

fields.name: CellPointerArray
fields.description: Array of 2-byte big-endian offsets (relative to page start) pointing to each cell's location within the cell content area. Sorted in key order — leftmost (smallest key) first. Each offset enables direct navigation to individual cell records.

fields.name: UnallocatedSpace
fields.description: **Forensically critical** — unallocated gap between the cell pointer array and the cell content area. This region frequently contains remnants of deleted records that have not yet been overwritten. Data recovery tools can extract deleted rows, dropped table data, and modified record fragments from this space.

fields.name: CellContentArea
fields.description: Cell content area containing actual cell records, packed toward the end of the page. For table leaf pages (0x0D): each cell is varint payload size + varint rowid + record payload (header + column data). For index leaf pages (0x0A): each cell is varint payload size + index key record.
